title: SQLite and DuckDB stories beat MongoDB and MySQL stories on points
question: Does a story about SQLite or DuckDB get more points than a story about MongoDB or MySQL?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about SQLite or DuckDB gets more points than a story about MongoDB or MySQL.
expect: If true, points per SQLite/DuckDB story should be at least 1.5x the points per MongoDB/MySQL story, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per SQLite/DuckDB story against points per MongoDB/MySQL story

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h309, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h309 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a product is not proof the story is about that product, and one story can match both lists.
Both lists are title words only, so stories that never name the product are missed.
